readme:
# Immowelt.de Scraper

Scrape real estate listings from [immowelt.de](https://www.immowelt.de), one of Germany's largest property platforms.

## How To Use

### Option 1: Paste a search URL (recommended)

Copy any immowelt.de search URL from your browser with all your filters applied:

```json
{
  "searchUrls": [
    "https://www.immowelt.de/liste/berlin/wohnungen/mieten",
    "https://www.immowelt.de/liste/muenchen/haeuser/kaufen"
  ],
  "maxResults": 30
}
```

### Option 2: Use city and filters

```json
{
  "city": "berlin",
  "listingType": "mieten",
  "propertyType": "wohnung",
  "maxResults": 30
}
```

## Use with AI Agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client — Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents.

**Apify MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/immowelt-de-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `immowelt-de-scraper` to scrape company data from immowelt de. Return results as a table."

Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) will receive the full input schema automatically via `add-actor`.

## What You Get

### Property data
- Title, headline, description
- Price (warm rent, cold rent, or purchase price)
- Rooms, area (m²), floor, plot size
- Property type and subtype (studio, penthouse, etc.)
- Energy class, availability date
- Full address with city and postcode
- All listing images

### Agent / company data
- Company name (100% of listings)
- Contact phone number (80% of listings)
- Agency website, address, profile URL, imprint URL
- Publisher type (agency or private owner)
- Premium partner badge

## Pricing

Pay-per-result pricing. You only pay for the data you receive.

| Event | Price | Description |
|-------|-------|-------------|
| Listing scraped | $0.003 | A property listing with all available data |

**Examples:**
- 30 Berlin apartments = **$0.09**
- 100 listings = **$0.30**

No monthly fees. No minimum spend.

## Supported URL Formats

- `https://www.immowelt.de/liste/berlin/wohnungen/mieten` — standard search
- `https://www.immowelt.de/liste/deutschland/haeuser/kaufen` — all Germany
- `https://www.immowelt.de/classified-search?distributionTypes=Buy&...` — auto-converted

Note: `/classified-search` URLs are automatically converted to `/liste/` format. For best results with all filters preserved, use `/liste/` URLs directly.
